title: Study of Treatment of Thoracic Aortic Aneurysms and Dilatation in Combination With Tricuspid and Bicuspid Aortic Valves.
brief_summary: Clarification of indications for surgical correction in patients with borderline expansion of the ascending aorta
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Extension of the ascending aorta less than 55 mm
2. Tricuspid Aortic Valves.
3. Extension of the ascending aorta more than 45 mm

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Age less 45 years
2. Age more 75 years
3. Multiple organ failure
4. oncological disease
study_population: Patients with computed tomography-diagnosed ascending aortic dilation greater than 45 mm, less than 55 mm with tricuspid aortic valve compared to patients with bicuspid aortic valve and healthy volunteers
